title: CPSC, H & M Announce Recall of Girls' Sweaters with Faux Fur Trim
summary: The furry trim on the sweaters is dangerously flammable. Units: About 470.

title: CPSC, Once Upon a Family Announce Recall of Memory Trunks
summary: The lid can fall on a child who is looking or reaching inside, entrapping the child at the neck, which poses a risk of strangulation. Also, the lid can close and self-fasten, entrapping the child inside the trunk, which poses a suffocation hazard. Units: About 1,600.

title: CPSC, Country Home Products, Inc. Announce Recall to Repair DR®Leaf and Lawn Vacuum
summary: These leaf and lawn vacuums have a plastic elbow and blower exit adaptor that is connected to the top of the shredding chamber. The plastic can crack, allowing stones, large sticks, and other material to puncture the plastic. This creates the possibility that pieces of plastic or other debris can fl

title: CPSC, Rossignol, and Dynastar Announce Recall of Snowboard Bindings
summary: The baseplate of the binding can break, resulting in loss of control and possible fall and injury to the snowboarder. Units: About 11,000 pairs.

title: CPSC and Gardener's Supply Company are recalling the Rope Candle and Holder (34-911)
summary: The candle has a clamp (vise) that leads the end of the rope candle at the top. When clamped properly it is supposed to self-extinguish the candle when the burning wick meets the metal clamp (vise). The clamp (vise) does not always sever the wax close to the wick and does not always enable the wick

title: CPSC, Cannondale Bicycle Corporation Announce Recall of Bicycle Suspension Seat Posts
summary: The seat posts may have been improperly manufactured, which could cause the seat post to fail prematurely. A failure could lead to a crack in the bicycle seat post, which may cause the rider to fall or crash. Units: About 1,480.

title: CPSC, GE Announce Recall of Built-In Dishwashers
summary: These dishwashers have a connector that can short-circuit and overheat during normal use, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 74,300.

title: CPSC, Kolpin Powersports Announce Recall of Youth ATVs
summary: Metal-flange locking nuts securing the tie rod assemblies, integral to the steering system on the Youth ATV, can come loose. The resulting unstable steering condition could result in serious injury or death to a rider. Units: About 1,000 90cc units and 39 50cc units.

title: CPSC, Target Corp. Announce Recall of Women's Boots
summary: The heel on the boot can detach from the sole while in use, causing the consumer to fall. Units: About 135,000.

title: CPSC, Charles Products Announce Recall of Toddler Drinking Cups
summary: A container inside the cup holds petroleum distillates, which can leak onto the outside of the cup and could come into contact with the user, posing a poisoning hazard to children. Units: 720.

title: CPSC, GSI Commerce Solutions Announce Recall of Electric Scooters
summary: A knob can loosen and cause the handlebar to detach from the scooter. Additionally, the folding joint lock on the model FS-101 scooter can break, causing the handlebars to release from the upright position. Both hazards can cause the rider to lose control and fall from the scooter. Units: About 4,30

title: CPSC, Dollar General Corp. Announce Recall of Dive Sticks
summary: Children can fall or land on these upright dive sticks in shallow water and suffer impalement injuries. CPSC banned pre-weighted dive sticks in 2001. Units: About 180,000 dive stick packages.

title: CPSC, Brave Products Announce Recall of Log Splitters
summary: The log splitter's hydraulic cylinders can have defective rod retention, causing the seals to leak and the rods to detach. This can result in serious injury to the operator, as the rod can rapidly and unexpectedly extend the splitting wedge. Units: About 4,000.

title: CPSC, HIS International Announce Recall of Jumper Sets
summary: The paint on the buttons contains excessive lead levels, posing a lead poisoning hazard to young children. Units: About 6,700.

title: CPSC, Sea Gull Lighting Products Announce Recall of Ceiling Light Fixtures
summary: Due to a manufacturing defect in a component part, the light fixture could fall and strike a person beneath the light fixture. The fixture also poses a laceration risk if the lamp breaks. Units: About 2,700.

title: CPSC, Wal-Mart Stores Announce Recall of Reef Rocker Infant Toys
summary: The seam on the plastic balls can separate, releasing the small toy inside and posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 54,260.

title: CPSC, American Standard Companies Announce Recall of Gas-Electric Heating/Cooling Units
summary: A gas leak can occur if there is a crack in the gas valve body near the inlet pipe connection. A build-up of gas in the burner compartment of the unit could occur, which could be ignited by an internal spark. Units: About 18,200.

title: CPSC, Big Save International Announce Recall of Baby Walkers
summary: The walkers fit through a standard doorway and are not designed to stop at the edge of a step. Additionally, these walkers can tip-over. Babies using these walkers can be seriously injured or killed. Units: About 12,000.

title: CPSC, BISSELL Announce Recall to Repair Upright Carpet Cleaners
summary: The carpet cleaner's metal upper handle can pose an electric shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 750,000.

title: CPSC, Stihl Inc. Announce Recall of Multi-Task Tools
summary: An internal clip may become dislodged and, as a result, the clutch shoes could be projected from the clutch housing and strike consumers, posing the risk of injury. Units: About 45,000.

title: CPSC, Arett Sales Corp. Announce Recall of Multi-Purpose Barbecue Lighters
summary: The lighters lack child-resistant mechanisms that meet federal safety standards. Young children could operate these lighters, which pose a fire hazard. Federal standards require multi-purpose lighters to have the same level of child-resistance as required in the safety standard for cigarette lighter

title: CPSC, Giftco Announce Recall of Fork in Winnie the Pooh Baby Plate Set
summary: The plastic fork prongs in the plate set can break, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 26,157.

title: CPSC, New Star Toys & Gifts Inc. Announce Recall of Toy Cars
summary: Small parts can break off during use, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,200.

title: CPSC, Shimano American Corp. Announce Brake Inner Cable Recall
summary: The bicycle brake cable can detach during braking, causing the rider to lose control and fall. Units: About 13,630.

title: CPSC, Bits and Pieces Announce Recall of Metallic Motion Lamps
summary: The lamp may shatter in use, causing a threat of serious injury from glass. Units: About 2,100.

title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. ("BRP") Announce Recall of Snowmobiles
summary: Inappropriate clutch ring gear installed on some units. This may cause ring gear fragmentation at high speeds and debris could act as projectiles. A projectile could cause serious injury or death. Units: About 1,455.

title: CPSC, Todo Dollar Wholesale Announce Recall of Pacifiers
summary: The nipple can detach from the pacifier, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 102,000.

title: CPSC, Vernier Software & Technology Announce Recall of Go!™ Temp Temperature Sensors
summary: When connected to a computer, a static discharge to the sensor can cause the sensor to draw too much current from the computer, causing the sensor to get hot. The sensor can get hot enough to cause a burn to the skin or damage objects in contact with it. Units: About 4,300.

title: CPSC, Deb Shops Announce Recall of Decorative Candleholders
summary: The hook or handle of the candleholder can overheat and break, causing the lit candle to fall out and pose a fire hazard. Units: About 48,000.

title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motors Corp. USA Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: On some units, the nut which secures the front upper suspension arm pivot bolt could come loose during vehicle use. Continued use of the vehicle could allow the nut to come off, and the upper suspension A-arm pivot bolt to back partially out. This would result in a loss of steering control, and poss

title: CPSC, Dollar Tree Stores Inc. Announce Recall of Electronic Musical Toys
summary: The ball on the end of the drumstick sold with these toys can break off during use, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 147,600.

title: CPSC, Tiffany and Company Announce Recall of Farm Teether Rattles
summary: A metal bar on the rattle can break off during use, releasing small round beads and small farm animal figures that roll off the crossbar when the soldered joints break. The beads can pose an aspiration hazard to young children. The breakage also can create ragged edges on the ring, posing a lacerati

title: CPSC, Whirlpool Corporation Announce Recall of Dishwashers
summary: An electrical defect within the dishwashers' wash motor wiring poses a risk of the motor overheating and possibly catching fire. Units: About 162,000.

title: CPSC, Cressi-Sub Announce Recall of SCUBA Buoyancy Compensators
summary: A slow leak from the shoulder exhaust caused by expansion of an internal cable housing could result in slow deflation. This could impact the diver's ability to control buoyancy. Units: About 1,000.

title: CPSC, Kmart Corp. Announce Recall of Martha Stewart Everyday Brand Birch Candle Set Sold Exclusively at Kmart
summary: The birch, surrounding the candles, may ignite, posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 4,600.

title: CPSC, Head USA Inc. Announce Recall of SCUBA Diving Computers
summary: The dive computers were improperly calibrated, resulting in incorrect calculations. Diving with an improperly calibrated dive computer can provide inaccurate "No Decompression (no stop) Time," "Decompression Time," "Desaturation Time" and "No Fly Time." This could result in divers suffering serious

title: CPSC, Playtex Products Inc., Announce Recall of Hip Hammock Child Carriers
summary: The shoulder strap support can detach from the hammock, posing a fall hazard to the baby. Units: About 32,000.
